name: Thanksgiving Uncle
tagline: A liberal family's Thanksgiving table, and Uncle Rick at the end of it with a beer, a dog coin and some questions. Every step up the multiplier takes him deeper, from the communist turkey to the 5G gravy to the oat milk and the cat, while Dad does a land acknowledgment, the niece calls him a microaggression, the smart speaker orders horse paste and his dog revs the truck in the driveway. Cash out and Grandma says grace before Dale comes through the wall and takes the rug with him. There is no such thing as bad press.
